action_semantics: legacy-v1-frame-centre; known multi-tile and stationary reversals
stop: first cleared level, native game-over, decision cap or active simulation-frame cap; continue after deaths
loop_definition: repeated position sequence of period 2..64 with at least 3 distinct tiles, within one life and without consuming a pellet
avoidable_death_definition: chosen action loses a life before its next legacy decision boundary, while another legal action from identical native state and RNG does not; no claim of eventual survival
secondary_metrics: 256 snapshot teacher agreement and safety strata
censoring: caps are unresolved episodes, never wins or game-overs; report raw counts and per-seed paired differences
split_rule: seeds reserved for evaluation, disjoint from every packaged v1 data split; never use their trajectories for new training
generalization_scope: same classic maze, starting level 1, five seeds; no held-out-layout or higher-level claim
